# containment parent

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:containmentParent`](gmeow-containmentParent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/containmentParent>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The containing (parent) place in this containment tenure. Functional: a single tenure has exactly one parent place.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ContainmentTenure`](../classes/gmeow-ContainmentTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:containmentParent`](gmeow-containmentParent.md) from [`gmeow:ContainmentTenure`](../classes/gmeow-ContainmentTenure.md) to [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:ContainmentTenure`](../classes/gmeow-ContainmentTenure.md), [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the single containing (parent) place of a containment tenure; functional.

### Avoid when

- Avoid multiple parents on one tenure — disputed parallel parents are multiple standpoint-indexed tenures ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:containmentParent`](gmeow-containmentParent.md) per [`ContainmentTenure`](../classes/gmeow-ContainmentTenure.md).

### Examples

- ex:ct [`gmeow:containmentParent`](gmeow-containmentParent.md) ex:countyOld.
